title: Witness: P41M withdrawn from Mans Carpio’s account in an hour ‘unusual’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P41-million cash withdrawal made within an hour and 13 minutes was “unusual” and raised questions about the lack of a clear transaction trail, a financial analyst testified during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday. Alexander Cabrera, a lawyer and accountant presented by the prosecution as an expert witness on Article II of the impeachment complaint, made the observation in response to questions from Sen.
